Your iRacing races from iRacing's Data A: Your iRacing races from iRacing's Data API: wins, laps at each track, ratings over time and much more, in graphs and tables
iRacing's Data API signs in with OAuth:: iRacing's Data API signs in with OAuth: your iRacing account (email and password) and an OAuth client of your own, which iRacing gives you (a client ID and a client secret, for the "password limited" sign-in, with your account on the client's list of users). The password and secret are sent masked, as iRacing asks, and kept here encrypted for your Windows account. Two-factor sign-in isn't asked for this kind of client.

A sync fetches only what's new since the: A sync fetches only what's new since the last one (the first fetches every race since you joined, 90 days at a time, which takes a minute or two), and your ratings and iRacing's totals again. iRacing limits how often its API is called: when the limit is reached, the sync waits and carries on.
Your races, ratings and totals are kept: Your races, ratings and totals are kept in the iRacing folder of the app's local data, so the tab shows them at once and a sync only fetches what's new.
